title: SvgSet
responsibility: Renders the native set element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgSet.attributes
inputs.description: Native set attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgSet.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native set element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgSet
outputs.description: The actual native set element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
